facts.fact: 她傍晚回到 Carlinsrest，先去五金店还 Rowan 的卡车钥匙；Fergus 正在店里替 Rowan 代班，她把钥匙丢在柜台上，谎称“忘了还，我得先走”
facts.anchor: I marched past the rows of wood paint, twine and work gloves and dropped the truck keys on the counter.

facts.fact: Fergus 主动问她“你那闹鬼的房子住得怎么样”；她本已转身要走，为了“Fairy Mirror”这条线索又留下
facts.anchor: “How are you getting on with your haunted house?”

facts.fact: Fergus 讲起八九岁时一个从城里来的男孩：母子短住、深居简出、每天接送，男孩右脸有一块从眼角越过面颊到耳朵的 port wine 胎记
facts.anchor: Except, he had this birthmark. A port wine stain, I think it’s called.

facts.fact: 某个周一男孩脸色惨白、眼袋很深、校服没洗，一见他就扑进怀里；随后说母亲近来心不在焉、周日晚在沙发上睡着
facts.anchor: Except for one Monday, when I got into school after my paper round—I was always the first one in on Mondays—and there he was waiting at the school door, face pale, bags under his eyes and this thousand-yard stare.

facts.fact: 夜里两点男孩听见母亲在楼下轻声叫他下楼；穿衣下楼时浴室门开了，母亲躲在里面摇头、比口型说“屋里有东西”，而楼下仍传来她的声音叫他去厨房
facts.anchor: The mum peeking out from behind the bathroom shook her head and mouthed, There’s something in the house.

facts.fact: 男孩无法确定楼下那个是不是母亲，用床抵住卧室门，从窗户爬屋顶逃走，跳进后花园，跑去学校等到天亮
facts.anchor: “He said he couldn’t know for sure which one was her. So, he pushed one of the beds up against the door, then he opened the bedroom window and escaped out over the roof.

facts.fact: 第二天放学母亲准时来接，说“都结束了”，男孩跟她回家；此后他没再来，老师说他家搬走了；几周后他又出现在校门口，脸上胎记没了，说“I changed it, so Mum could be safe.”
facts.anchor: He was back. But as I got close, I saw he was missing that birthmark.

facts.fact: 她问“他的房子就是我的房子吧”，Fergus 先冷脸后大笑“Got you”，承认这是专骗游客的都市传说“my-not-mum-called-me-from-downstairs”；Rowan 赶到，她一言不发走出店门
facts.anchor: “I just told her the old my-not-mum-called-me-from-downstairs urban legend and she believed me.
